ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows that this area has equal-number-of-days lines of seasonal frozen soil. The equal-number-of-days lines as a whole are roughly distributed in a near east-west direction, indicating that they are related to latitudinal changes in the north-south direction; but the local equal-number-of-days lines bend obviously in the middle and deviate from the direction of the latitude lines. Then reason: the question stem has already given that one of the influencing factors is the latitude factor, so it is necessary to determine the other main factor that causes the local bending of the equal-number-of-days lines. The number of days of frozen soil is affected by temperature, while elevation, mountains, and other terrain can change the distribution of temperature and cause the equal-number-of-days lines to bend, so the other main factor is the terrain factor.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出图中等日数线总体随纬度变化呈近东西向分布，但在局部明显弯曲。再结合题干已给出“纬度因素”，判断剩余导致等日数线偏离纬线方向的主要原因。由于海拔和山地地形会改变气温与冻结日数，所以填“地形因素”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中显示该地区有季节性冻土等日数线，等日数线总体大致呈近东西向分布，说明与南北方向的纬度变化有关；但局部等日数线在中部明显弯曲、偏离纬线方向。再推理：题干已经给出影响因素之一是纬度因素，因此需要判断导致等日数线局部弯曲的另一主要因素。冻土日数受气温影响，而海拔高低、山地等地形会改变气温分布，使等日数线发生弯曲，所以另一主要因素是地形因素。
